The '''1932–33''' [[La Liga]] season began on 27 November 1932 and finished on 28 March 1933. Holders [[Real Madrid|Madrid FC]] retained their title.

[[Real Betis|Betis]] became the first club from [[Andalusia]] to compete in La Liga during this season.
